title: GPT-Live: Full-Duplex Voice Models for ChatGPT
hook: Voice assistants that wait their turn to speak have always felt a little robotic. GPT-Live listens and talks at the same time — interjecting a quiet 'mhmm' or letting you think, mid-sentence.
key_points: GPT-Live is a new generation of voice models replacing the existing ChatGPT voice experience, rolling out as GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini.
Full-duplex architecture: the model can listen and speak simultaneously, backchanneling ('mhmm', 'yeah') and staying quiet when the user needs a moment.
For questions needing web search, deeper reasoning, or complex work, it delegates behind the scenes to OpenAI's frontier model (GPT-5.5 at launch) and brings the result back into the conversation.
Supports natural interruption — users can interject with a question, pause, or ask it to slow down, and it acknowledges without breaking flow.
content_html: Voice assistants have long had an awkward rhythm: wait for the user to finish, then respond, then wait again. GPT-Live is OpenAI's attempt to close that gap, built on a full-duplex architecture that can listen and speak at the same time.
extra_html: Rolling out as two versions — GPT-Live-1 and a smaller GPT-Live-1 mini — to ChatGPT users globally, GPT-Live replaces the existing ChatGPT voice experience. The full-duplex design lets it backchannel with small acknowledgments like "mhmm" or "yeah," stay quiet while a user gathers their thoughts, and handle interruptions without breaking conversational flow — you can interject with a question, ask it to slow down, or pause mid-sentence. OpenAI also describes it as the smartest voice model yet: for questions that need web search, deeper reasoning, or more complex work, GPT-Live delegates behind the scenes to the company's latest frontier model — GPT-5.5 at launch — and folds the result back into the conversation once it's ready, rather than making the user wait through visible "thinking" the way earlier voice modes did. OpenAI, 2026-07-08.

related.title: Whisper: Robust Speech Recognition at Scale
related.hook: Train a plain encoder-decoder transformer on 680,000 hours of weakly-labeled multilingual audio and you get near-human transcription robustness without task-specific fine-tuning.

related.title: GPT-4o: One Model for Text, Audio, and Vision
related.hook: GPT-4o is a single model that natively processes text, audio, and images end-to-end - no separate speech pipeline - cutting voice response latency to near human conversational speed.

flashcards.prompt: What is 'full-duplex' architecture in GPT-Live, and why does it matter for conversation?
flashcards.back_html: The model can listen and speak at the same time — backchanneling with sounds like "mhmm," staying quiet when the user needs to think, and handling interruptions naturally — instead of the turn-taking, wait-your-turn pattern of prior voice assistants.

flashcards.prompt: How does GPT-Live handle questions that need deep reasoning or web search mid-conversation?

choices.text: It delegates behind the scenes to OpenAI's frontier model (GPT-5.5 at launch) and brings the result back into the live conversation once ready
It refuses to answer and asks the user to switch to text chat
It always answers immediately using only its own voice-model weights, without ever calling out to another model
It ends the conversation and requires the user to start a new session

flashcards.explanation_html: GPT-Live is described as delegating harder queries to OpenAI's latest frontier model in the background, then folding the result back into the live voice conversation — combining natural conversational flow with deeper reasoning when needed.
